resolution.question: Will at least one member of Riverton's parks committee vote against the skate-park relocation when it comes up at Thursday's session?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one committee member voted against the skate-park relocation during the Thursday session (2026-09-17). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff (2026-09-17T22:00:00-06:00).
